description: Governer Office - North Central Province - Mr. T. M. M. A. P. Thennakoon is fit to be reinstated in the post of Chairman of Rambewa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the reinstatement of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local government) Chairman following an inquiry conducted by a retired High Court Judge. The content is primarily about a judicial/administrative process related to a local government official and the exercise of powers vested in the Provincial Governor. It falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it involves the application of a specific act, an inquiry by a judicial officer, and a decision regarding a local government position's fitness to hold office.
